Round-10 directive: scripts/independent_verifier_v2.py is a standalone addition to AutoDev. The AED source commit b57fcaad does not contain an independent verifier script at any path. The verifier was introduced in AutoDev to perform the FRESH strict qualification cycle (>=180 seconds) on PR #4. The production verifier embeds every required gate, fails closed on any drift, and the optimized-Python refuse guard is the module-import __debug__ callback.

Newly authored regression tests for PR #4 round-3 review findings: canonical-write failure injection with retry, CLI does not duplicate canonical write, verifier measured-evidence lineage, cross-process holder/contender PID identity. The PID test catches the parent-os.getpid()-interpolation defect.

Newly authored regression tests for PR #4 round-4 review findings: balanced GraphQL query builders, totalCount-required pagination, positive live PR readiness, explicit-latest CodeRabbit review via submittedAt sorting, incident-record self-authentication removed (verifier does not create sidecars), StateError post-merge COMPLETE recovery, failed-verifier canonical semantics. Loads scripts/independent_verifier_v2.py as a module and exercises _inspect_coderabbit and _verify_incident_record with mocked GraphQL responses rather than relying on source inspection alone.
cli.py cmd_merge and cmd_post_merge_verify recovery payloads include merge_record_path, merge_record_sha256, recovery_required, and recovery_action. Round-5 hardening directive.

Round-8 nitpick: optimize-python negative-existence test wraps the Path composition inside the assertFalse call so the BinOp is structurally contained inside the assertFalse Call (not a separate variable). The prior line-arithmetic exemption was wrong for this case; the AST containment check now correctly exempts the BinOp.

Round-9 directive: PRRT_kwDOTtyQLc6XXFOx (safe offenders diagnostic; no offenders[0] indexing before the length assertion; the diagnostic is safe for [], one, and many offenders), PRRT_kwDOTtyQLc6XXFO3 (test docstring correction: page 1 returns hasNextPage=True and an endCursor; production paginator forwards that cursor on its second request; second mocked network call rejects the unexpected cursor; VerificationFailure propagates through real paginator). Also replaced the line-range AST containment check with AST node-id descendant tracking (true AST containment, not line overlap). Trimmed _make_args to only fields _inspect_ci actually reads (removed aed_path, aed_expected_sha, strict_window_obs, evidence_root -- removed the per-call file hashing for aed_expected_sha). Added Round9SafeDiagnosticsTests (3 tests: empty offenders diagnostic, one offender, many offenders) and Round9PaginatorPreservationTests (re-runs the real-paginator behavioral proof). Added a Round-9 regression case for an offender that shares a line with assertFalse but is NOT its argument (line-range overlap would wrongly exempt it; AST node-id containment correctly detects it).

Round-8 nitpick: shared _is_gh_pr_merge matcher requires exact argv adjacency (argv[0]=='gh', argv[1]=='pr', argv[2]=='merge') and safely handles calls without positional arguments. _count_gh_pr_merge_calls and _find_gh_pr_merge_call now delegate to the shared matcher.

Round-10 directive: scripts/quiet_window_observer.py is a standalone addition to AutoDev. It was not extracted from AED PR #417 (the AED reference commit b57fcaad does not contain a file at scripts/local/quiet_window_observer.py). The file is required by the production verifier (default --aed-path) and was added to AutoDev's seed. The manifest audit entry remains: measured sha256 = sha256 of destination file (verified) and the audit counts this file as a standalone addition.
